def transform(grid):
    """Shift every row down by one; fill the newly exposed top row with the background color."""
    if not grid or not grid[0]:
        return []
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[background] * len(grid[0])] + [row[:] for row in grid[:-1]]
